description: This file defines the PHP class 'TemplateRange', which extends 'TemplateText' and provides additional functionality for handling range-based search fields in the SuiteCRM modding environment. It includes methods for populating search options from POST requests, getting field definitions with range search enabled, and repairing search fields configuration. The class supports enabling ranged search on date, datetime, and numeric fields, and integrates with the SuiteCRM metadata and cache system.

classes.name: TemplateRange
classes.description: A class extending TemplateText to add range search capabilities for fields in SuiteCRM, including enabling range search, populating search parameters from POST data, and providing field definitions with range options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the TemplateRange class, mapping 'enable_range_search' and 'options' properties.

methods.name: populateFromPost
methods.description: Populates range search settings from POST request, and updates search fields configuration files accordingly.

methods.name: get_field_def
methods.description: Returns the field definition array, augmenting it with range search options if enabled.

methods.name: repairCustomSearchFields
methods.description: A static method to repair or initialize search fields configuration for fields with range search enabled, updating the corresponding metadata files.
